text:
Quiet morning light
seeds of courage start to bloom
you begin again
You don't have to feel ready to begin. Readiness usually shows up after the first step, not before it.

Storm clouds pass and fade
the sun was always still there
so is your own strength
The fact that this is hard doesn't mean you're doing it wrong. It means you're doing something worth doing.

One foot then the next
the path was never finished
still, you keep walking
You've gotten through every hard day so far. That's not luck, that's a track record.

Doubt is just weather
it passes through, then moves on
you remain, whole
Progress you can't see yet is still progress. Keep going.

Small root breaks the stone
patience is its quiet strength
you are built the same
You are allowed to be a beginner. Everyone worth admiring started exactly where you are.
